PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
This is for information that the Hon'ble Court have been pleased to approve the
vacancy position (existing I anticipated) (cadre I quota wise) for the year 2024-25 in the
following manner:-
Sl. No. Cadre I Quota Number of Vacancies
1. District Judge (Entry Level) against 50% quota (-76)
(By Promotion)
2. District Judge (Entry Level) against 25% quota 32
(Through Limited Departmental Competitive
Examination)
3. District Judge (Entry Level) against 25% quota 0
(Direct from Bar)
4. Civil Judge (Senior Division) against 90% 91
quota (By Promotion)
5. Civil Judge (Senior Division) against 10% 42
quota (Through Limited Departmental
Competitive Examination)
6. Civil Judge (Junior Division) 139
It is further stated that the number of vacancies may vary as the aforesaid
vacancies are in anticipation of promotion of officers to higher cadres.
Patna High Court, Patna.
Dated: 30.03.2026
By order of the Court
